comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. GitHub #608's design (mitcad#2330; tools/cli/fillet-full-round-order-reported-test.cmake) with Fillet1 a Full Round, in both orders. The circle touching the end face, the left face and the cut face (63.02 degrees between the left face's and the cut face's normals, the left face 16.680428 wide) has radius 16.680428 / (1 + tan(31.51 degrees)) = 10.341253.

The design's order: Fillet2 (14.2), then Fillet1 as a Full Round. Body1 is 63235.172688 before the fillets (fillet_narrow_face_tangent_reported.json). Fillet2 adds the section between the bottom, the riser, the half disc and the ball's arc along the depth, less its part past the cut: 592.536944. Fillet1 takes r^2 (1 - pi/4) + r^2 (tan(a/2) - a/2) off the corner along the left face's height 29.233384: 868.094162. Its rounding of the end face's left edge reaches the bottom 10.34 from the left face, past Fillet2's contact (11.995 left of the riser, 7.13 from the left face): the part of Fillet2's section under that rounding's corner is not added, 0.019491 (Simpson's rule). 63235.172688 + 592.536944 - 868.094162 - 0.019491 = 62959.59598.
The other order, Fillet1 (Full Round) moved before Fillet2: the same body, no lip standing out past the Full Round at the step's height.
